subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: What Feishu direct-message identity and retention policy should OpenClaw enforce for multi-account DMs, and how should existing malformed or unscoped direct session keys be repaired?
rationale: The fix affects session-history continuity, direct-DM retention, Feishu identity validation, and upgrade repair behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent policy alone.

options.title: Validate and Repair Feishu DM Keys
options.body: Validate Feishu direct open_id shape at the plugin boundary, keep account-scoped DM keys for multi-app setups, and add doctor or migration repair for malformed and duplicate direct-session rows.

options.title: Add TTL-Aware Direct Retention
options.body: Protect recent direct-message sessions from generic pruning while still allowing old one-off direct sessions to age out under an explicit retention policy.

options.title: Wait for Live Repro
options.body: Keep the documented workaround and request a sanitized session store or live Feishu reproduction before changing validation, pruning, or repair behavior.

recommendation.title: Validate and Repair Feishu DM Keys
recommendation.body: Validate Feishu direct open_id shape at the plugin boundary, keep account-scoped DM keys for multi-app setups, and add doctor or migration repair for malformed and duplicate direct-session rows.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history across both session maintenance and Feishu-adjacent runtime work, which makes them the best available routing owner for the cross-surface policy choice.
